current_answer: OpenAI plugins are installable packages of skills, tool connections or both; the universal directory distributes them for supported hosts, not universal execution or access. For a configured-marketplace plugin in Codex CLI that is installed/enabled but missing its required skill or MCP tool, preserve the exact failure, inspect configured marketplace/source and installed/enabled state, then only the relevant selection/current-session capability branch. Distinguish source/ref → installed/enabled → observed selection/session capability → actual authorized output. Resolve only an evidenced mismatch through supported owning controls; otherwise retain a redacted versioned failure for the responsible maintainer/admin. This is our documentary diagnostic, not an official universal troubleshooter, identified cause or tested repair. Prior public-ZIP restrictions and separate host/provider/public gates remain in force within their saved scopes/dates.
